why: The named, shrink-only record of every check `make verify` is allowed to record as SKIP (rc 2 CANNOT-ASSESS) -- scripts/verify.sh's skip ratchet (issue #1199). A skip is named here or the run is REFUSED by name: the composite will not publish a `verify: PASS` whose skip set is narrated by nobody. Three kinds, all precise: `venue` (the check cannot assess because a NAMED PRECONDITION this venue must supply is not supplied -- honoured only while it is NOT supplied, so it de-activates itself the moment the venue supplies it; a check that still cannot assess WITH its precondition supplied is a defect of the CHECK, #1176, and is refused by name). A venue precondition has exactly TWO measured forms, never an assertion: a repo-relative PATH that must be absent (`vendor/CMR/sync`), and a COMMAND this venue must be able to run (`gh auth status`, supplied only when the command exits 0). The command form is the check's OWN probe quoted verbatim -- scripts/check-skip-ratchet.sh refuses a command that no file under scripts/ runs, so this record cannot invent a precondition nobody measures -- and `standing-gap` (the check's inputs ARE present and it still cannot assess, so it must name the OPEN issue that tracks it and is STALE the moment it assesses -- the entry must then be deleted) and `live-dependent` (the check's ASSESSABILITY is a property of the WORLD, #1410: the entry names the LIVE `mechanism` that did not answer and the OPEN issue that tracks it, is honoured BY NAME while the check cannot assess, is NOT stale when the check assesses -- reported as not biting, never failed -- and is REFUSED when the check FAILS, because a failing check is a FINDING, not a skip. It declares no precondition: a precondition is a named thing THIS VENUE supplies, and this kind's blindness is not this venue's to supply). An entry that matters is matched EXACTLY (check + kind + the declared precondition, or the issue), so it cannot widen to cover a different blindness.

entries.mechanism: the GitHub branch-protection source, read live with gh (gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/branches/master/protection)
entries.reason: kind: live-dependent -- #1410, moved off `venue` (#1394). This check reads the LIVE GitHub protection, and it drives scripts/check-gate-status.sh's producer probe, whose LIVE half needs `gh` too. With `gh` supplied it assesses (measured: rc 0 on a box). With no `gh` at all it cannot, and where `gh` answers and the API read does not -- `gh-unauthenticated` / `gh-repo-unresolvable` / `gh-statuses-unreadable` -- it answers rc 2 NAMING THE SOURCE, exactly as its honesty contract requires. That last case is a property of the WORLD and not a defect of the check, which is what this kind says: honoured BY NAME while the mechanism cannot answer, NOT stale when the check assesses, and REFUSED the moment the check FAILS (rc 1), because a failing check is a finding, not a skip. It was a `standing-gap` because the producer probe could never assess, then a `venue` entry carrying the precondition `gh auth status`; that kind's refusal told the operator to repair a check that was behaving correctly whenever `gh` was present and the API still silent, which is the mislabel #1410 removes. Independent of #1382: nothing here is waiting on a producer to exist.

`CANNOT-ASSESS CMR_VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE: vendor/CMR/sync/validate-cmr-pin.py not present (vendor/CMR submodule not initialized?)` -- in Cloud Build the submodule cannot be initialised offline (`fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com'`), so this path is absent there and present in every worktree (#1361).
`check-cmr-pin: CANNOT-ASSESS -- vendor/CMR/sync/validate-cmr-pin.py not present (vendor/CMR submodule not initialized?)` -- the same absent precondition as cmr-knowledge (#1361).
`check-codeidx-surface: CANNOT-ASSESS - vendored mandatory seed unreadable: vendor/CMR/templates/module/.mcp.json (initialise vendor/CMR)` -- named by the check itself (#1361).

`check-diagrams-declaration: CANNOT-ASSESS - vendored contract unreadable: .../architecture-manifest.schema.json, .../gdc-manifest.schema.json, .../templates/module/gdc-manifest.yaml (initialise vendor/CMR)` -- the first of the three paths the check names (#1361).

`CANNOT-ASSESS compose-plugin-missing: install the docker compose v2 plugin (docker compose version must succeed)` -- and that is the probe this entry declares, verbatim from the check's own guard (scripts/check-fleet-cron-dev-run.sh). The Cloud Build container installs no docker (#1361).

`check-fleet-cron-image: CANNOT-ASSESS -- docker not found; the live controls were not run` (the declared-surface half is green; the live half is unreachable). `docker info` is the check's own probe of the daemon (scripts/check-fleet-cron-image.sh), supplied only when docker AND a reachable daemon are (#1361).

entries.mechanism: the GitHub commit-statuses source, read live with gh (gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/<sha>/statuses)
entries.reason: kind: live-dependent -- #1410, moved off `venue` (#1394). The producing question is answered in two halves. The TREE half (is a producer REACHED from the path that makes the PR verdict?) needs nothing of the venue, is provable offline, and is unchanged. The LIVE half is READ with `gh` -- the commit under test's statuses, then the most recent default-branch commits -- because the ONLY field the tree carries about liveness is infra/cloudbuild/verify-trigger.yaml's `disabled:`, and this repository PINS that `true` by policy (scripts/check-cloudbuild.sh requires "must ship disabled: true (GR-5)"), so a probe that reads it as live state names a condition the tree can never falsify. Measured 2026-09-19: the probe answered `CANNOT-ASSESS REQUIRED-BUT-GATED-OFF` (rc 2) while the live trigger is ENABLED and `ao/gate-of-record` is posted (2adbe48b, 83ff32db, 0dbb0e68). In a venue without a working `gh` the check therefore cannot assess -- that is a VENUE gap, named by the check's own probe, and this entry de-activates itself the moment the venue supplies `gh`. With `gh` supplied the check assesses: rc 0 when the context is observed producing, rc 1 BY NAME when the source WAS read and nothing is producing (a finding about the repository, not an inability to assess -- so not a skip). NOT a `standing-gap` (that kind goes STALE the moment the check assesses) and NOT a `venue` entry (#1410): supplying `gh` is not what this check needs, the commit-statuses SOURCE must answer. The residual #1394 measured is exactly why the move was needed: with `gh auth status` succeeding but the repository/API reads failing, the check answers rc 2 naming the source, and the `venue` kind then refused the entry with 'this is a defect of the check, not of the venue (#1176)' -- a red that was RIGHT (the required context's liveness genuinely cannot be established) carrying a SECOND REASON that was WRONG, telling the operator to repair a check that was behaving correctly. As `live-dependent` the entry is honoured BY NAME while the mechanism cannot answer, is NOT stale when the check assesses, and is REFUSED if the check FAILS (rc 1), because a failing check is a finding, not a skip.
`check-module-brief: CANNOT-ASSESS -- the pinned hub catalog is absent; expected vendor/CMR/catalog/mandatory.tsv and vendor/CMR/catalog/modules` -- named by the check itself (#1361).

`check-module-registry: CANNOT-ASSESS -- the pinned hub catalog is absent; expected vendor/CMR/catalog/mandatory.tsv and vendor/CMR/catalog/modules` -- the venue case this record documented from the start, now naming the open issue that tracks the CI half (#1361).

`check-reconcile-orphans: CANNOT-ASSESS -- gh not found; orphan-pr / orphan-issue-lane / orphan-directive cannot be measured on the real tree` -- `command -v gh` is the check's OWN guard (scripts/check-reconcile-orphans.sh), supplied only in a venue that has gh. The Cloud Build venue installs no gh (#1361). Measured 2026-09-19: three independent heads (a4919733, 81f8d3ff, 4b9a8488) all answered `verify: FAIL (0 of 215 checks failed, 13 skipped ... skip ratchet FAIL: 1 unnamed skip)` for this one unmapped skip, so no pull request could pass control-plane-verify (#1405).

`CANNOT-ASSESS gh-unauthenticated: gh is not installed` -- the same shared precondition library as branch-protection (scripts/lib/preconditions.sh, required by scripts/check-repo-settings.sh) (#1361).

`check-worktree-cap: CANNOT-ASSESS -- reaper schedule could not be determined: prune-worktrees: schedule: CANNOT-ASSESS -- crontab -l failed with rc=127: ... crontab: command not found`. The reaper's schedule is read from the LIVE crontab, by design (scripts/prune-worktrees.sh), so with no `crontab` binary the question cannot be answered at all. `crontab -l` is that probe quoted verbatim (#1361).

why-these-entries-exist: The list holds ONLY the gaps of the CLOUD BUILD venue (#1361) and no local one, and that is a measurement, not an omission. In the two venues a DEVELOPER produces, nothing skips: (a) a FRESH WORKTREE (`git worktree add` of this repo) was run end to end -- 202 checks rc 0, 1 check rc 1 (an unrelated `reconcile` real-tree drift baseline), 0 checks rc 2, verdict `verify: FAIL (1 of 203 checks failed)` with NO `skipped:` clause at all; (b) the populated checkout of the same commit. A skip that appears on the developer box is therefore a FINDING, not a known limit, and the ratchet refuses it by name with the remedy printed beside it -- which is the property this issue asked for: a skip bucket that cannot be permanently populated. Every entry that IS in this record is one of the required check's runner's own gaps: `control-plane-verify (purebliss-ghl)` runs `make verify` inside a bare `python:3.14` container with no `gh`, no docker (so no compose v2 plugin), no `crontab`, and no network with which to initialise `vendor/CMR`, so those twelve checks answer rc 2 there on EVERY run. That is filed as #1361, the open issue each entry names; supplying the tool or repairing the check deletes the entry, and a stale entry fails the run by name. Each of them is an `unused_venue_entry` on every local run -- a NOTE, never a failure -- and bites only in the venue whose precondition is genuinely absent.

Two of those entries carry the THIRD kind, `live-dependent` (#1410), and they are there because neither older kind can say what is true of them: as `venue` entries they were honoured only while their declared precondition (`gh auth status`) was NOT supplied, so the moment `gh` answered and the repository/API read still failed, the ratchet refused them as a defect of the CHECK rather than of the venue (#1176) -- the red was right and the REASON was wrong, telling the operator to repair a check that was behaving correctly. An authenticated-but-unreadable source is a property of the WORLD, so these two name the LIVE mechanism they depend on in `mechanism`, are honoured BY NAME while it cannot answer, do NOT go stale when the check assesses (reported as not biting -- on a developer box with a working `gh` both assess, rc 0), and are REFUSED the moment the check FAILS (rc 1), because a failing check is a FINDING, not a skip. The shrink-only property is kept: each names the OPEN issue (#1382) that tracks the mechanism.

The two checks that used to occupy the bucket are NOT here because they were REPAIRED, not because they were excused: `dispatch-queue` (#1189) and `paperclip-routines` (#1176) both reach real verdicts (measured at origin/master a60ab88: rc 0 each, 9 and 11 controls provoked). Naming them would be the fiction this ratchet exists to prevent.

The `venue` KIND is not hypothetical and was measured too: in a tree carrying no local submodule objects (so `git submodule update --init vendor/CMR` cannot succeed offline), `module-registry`, `diagrams-declaration` and `codeidx-surface` each answer rc 2 -- `the pinned hub catalog is absent` / `vendored contract unreadable` / `vendored mandatory seed unreadable` -- exactly as each check's own header declares. A lane in that venue names them with the precondition path it is missing, or supplies the submodule; it does not get a silent PASS.

Growing this list is a deliberate act naming the PRECONDITION the venue lacks -- a repo-relative PATH, or a COMMAND the venue must be able to run -- together with the OPEN issue that tracks supplying it (#1361 for the Cloud Build container); shrinking it is automatic -- an entry whose check assesses FAILS the run until the entry is deleted.
